{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Verify the data is now clean
df.info()
print(f"\nNumber of unique patients after deduplication: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"\nNumber of rows after deduplication: {len(df)}")
print(f"\nProportion of patients with responded=1: {df['responded'].mean():.3f}")

# Step 4: Check if arm and severity are confounded
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
print(crosstab)

df.head()"}
